blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 48 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 17, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & DELL lead 48 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 26 Canadian and 22 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of September 17, 2026) found 48 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 26 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 14 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +135% six-month return, and Energy is the most represented sector with 10 names.

In the U.S., 22 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 13 of them new to the list this week. Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) leads with a +258% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 9 names.
